h1: Luxury Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Los Angeles, 140 m²

blocks.text: Luxury Apartment Interior Design, Custom Furniture & Turnkey Renovation in Los Angeles, 140 m²

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN developed a comprehensive interior design project for a 140 m² apartment in Los Angeles, California, USA. The project combines luxury interior design, technical documentation, bespoke furniture solutions and planning for a comprehensive turnkey renovation.

The apartment interior was designed with an emphasis on contemporary aesthetics, functionality and a high level of everyday comfort. The space planning considers the characteristics of each room, furniture and appliance placement, integrated storage solutions, lighting and the visual connection between residential spaces.

The project covers a living room, bedrooms, a kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in wardrobes, an entrance hall, bathrooms and functional storage areas. All spaces follow a cohesive interior design concept, with carefully coordinated finishing materials, colour combinations, lighting and furniture solutions.

Custom furniture solutions were developed specifically for the apartment, including the kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving and integrated storage systems. Each furniture element was designed according to the room dimensions, layout requirements and overall interior style, allowing efficient use of space while maintaining a consistent visual identity throughout the property.

The preparation stage included technical documentation and a detailed cost estimate covering construction and finishing works, materials, furniture, household appliances, bathroom fixtures, lighting and other elements specified in the project. This approach helps establish the scope of work, coordinate technical solutions and plan the implementation budget in advance.

The project also includes planning for a comprehensive turnkey apartment renovation in Los Angeles, based on the developed interior concept and technical documentation. This approach brings together interior design, construction and finishing works, custom furniture production and furnishing within a coordinated implementation process.

Photorealistic 3D visualizations were created to present the proposed interior before implementation, illustrating the layouts, material combinations, furniture, lighting solutions and overall atmosphere of the rooms. These visualizations make it possible to evaluate the interior and approve key design decisions before construction begins.

This 140 m² apartment project in Los Angeles demonstrates DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s comprehensive approach to creating premium contemporary residential interiors — from initial design development and technical documentation to bespoke furniture solutions and preparation for complete interior implementation.
